title: App Hub
what: This app: all your apps in one place, with change requests.

health.data: Requests are GitHub issues in the Hub repo. Categories are saved to your account once you sign in, otherwise on this phone only.
health.backup: Requests are kept by GitHub. Categories sync to your account when signed in.
security: The Hub repo is public, so anyone who finds it can read your requests. Don't put passwords or personal details in a request.
issues: Sign in on App Hub so categories are backed up (add apps.ciarandevine.uk to Firebase Authorized domains first).

title: Ticket Time Tracker
what: Time on work tickets, ticket statuses, notes and CSV export.

health.data: Saved to your account (ciaran-apps), and each signed-in device keeps a copy.
health.backup: Cloud copy plus a copy on each device. Back up, Restore and Export CSV buttons in the app.
security: Only your signed-in account can read or change it.
issues: Uninstall the old Netlify copy and delete its Netlify project.

title: Bet Tracker
what: Bets, wins and losses across the season.

health.data: Saved to your account (ciaran-apps), and each signed-in device keeps a copy.
health.backup: Cloud copy plus a copy on each device. Back up (JSON), Restore and Export to spreadsheet (CSV) in the app.
security: Only your signed-in account can read or change it.
issues: Uninstall the old Netlify copy and delete its Netlify project.

title: Quizzle
what: Hard daily quiz with fresh, fact-checked questions every day.

health.data: Questions live in the repo. Your streak and today's progress are on this phone only.
health.backup: Questions are kept by GitHub. Your streak isn't backed up.
security: Nothing personal is stored.

title: TV Shows
what: TV rewatch tracker with episodes, watch log and history.

health.data: Saved to your account (ciaran-apps), and each signed-in device keeps a copy.
health.backup: Cloud copy plus a copy on each device. Backup, Download file and Import backup in the app.
security: Only your signed-in account can read or change it.

title: Betbuilder
what: Premier League stats, match picks and a prediction tracker.

health.data: Stats are rebuilt by a GitHub Action three times a day and kept in the repo. Only your hidden-player choices are on this phone.
health.backup: Everything can be rebuilt. Hidden-player choices aren't backed up.
security: Nothing personal is stored.

title: United Squad
what: Man United squad, transfers, managers and player stats.

health.data: Squad and stats live in the repo. Your saved line-ups and formations are on this phone only.
health.backup: Line-ups: Backup button in the app (download a file). Not synced to your account.
security: Nothing personal is stored.
issues: If this phone's site data is cleared, line-ups are lost unless you've downloaded a backup.

title: Workout Roulette
what: Random HIIT and stretching sessions with a timer and log.

health.data: Saved to your account (ciaran-apps) when signed in; signed out, this phone only.
health.backup: Cloud copy when signed in. Export and Import under Log, then Backup.
security: Only your signed-in account can read or change it.

title: Fantasy Football
what: Auction-draft fantasy league with standings and stats.

health.data: Firebase project fantasy-football-auction (league, squads, weekly results). No sign-in.
health.backup: No automatic backup. Squads and points can be re-imported from Excel, but admin changes made in the app would be lost.
security: The admin password is in the page code, so anyone who views the code can find it.
The database is open: anyone with the app's address could change or delete the league.
issues: Needs proper admin sign-in and locked database rules.
Friends use this app: changes are checked with you first.

title: Last Man Standing
what: Premier League last-player-standing game for the group.

health.data: Firebase project last-man-standing, with anonymous sign-in for players.
health.backup: No backup or export. The organiser can reload fixtures, but picks and results live only in the database.
security: Proper database rules check codes, deadlines and the organiser passcode on the server.
issues: Friends use this app: changes are checked with you first.

title: Lads Night Out
what: Group ledger, pot tracker and Lotto log.

health.data: Firebase project syndicate. No sign-in; a PIN hides the screens.
health.backup: Automatic daily cloud backup, kept about 60 days. Saving pauses with a Retry banner if loading fails.
security: The PIN is checked in the browser only, so the database itself is open to anyone with the app's address.
The daily backups are in the same open database, so they could be deleted too.
issues: Add sign-in and locked database rules.
Friends use this app: changes are checked with you first.

title: Match Predictor
what: Over 2.5 goals and both-teams-to-score chances, updated daily.

health.data: Match data is rebuilt every morning by a GitHub Action and kept in the repo. Your tracked picks are on this phone only.
health.backup: Match data can always be rebuilt. Your tracked picks aren't backed up.
security: Nothing personal is stored.
issues: If this phone's site data is cleared, your tracked picks are lost.

title: Daily Disciplines
what: Daily habits with streaks and XP, plus weight, calories and drinks.

health.data: Kept on this phone, with a sync copy in Firebase project daily-disciplines. No sign-in.
health.backup: Automatic daily cloud backups with Restore from backup. An empty phone can no longer overwrite the cloud (fixed 22 Oct).
security: The database is open: anyone with the app's address could read or change it, including weight and health entries.
issues: Lost all data on 22 Oct before the fix; habits need rebuilding.
Add sign-in and locked database rules.

title: Running Log
what: Running mileage, shoe rotation and race log.

health.data: Firebase project running-log, with email and password sign-in.
health.backup: Cloud copy. Export Data and Import Data under Backup & Restore.
security: Signed in with email and password.

title: The Ledger
what: Household bills, savings, credit card and calendar.

health.data: Firebase project bills-and-savings, shared by household, with anonymous sign-in. A local-only mode is available.
health.backup: Cloud copy. Bills and entries are saved separately, so one bad save can't wipe a list. No export button.
security: Uses anonymous sign-in rather than your account, so access depends on the household link rather than a password.
issues: No way to download a copy of your data.

health.data: Firebase project ivf-expenses, with email and password sign-in.
security: Signed in with email and password.
issues: No way to download a copy of your data.

title: GTO Hand Review
what: Review poker hands against game-theory-optimal play.

health.data: Saved to your account (ciaran-apps) once you've signed in on the Poker page; until then, this phone only.
security: Only your signed-in account can read or change it.
issues: Sign in once on the Poker page so the phone's hands upload.
Needs its own address (e.g. poker.ciarandevine.uk) before it can be installed.

title: Work Rota
what: Work hours by site, week by week (no longer used).

security: The database is open: anyone with the app's address could change or delete your hours.
issues: Not in use. Safe to leave, or archive the repo.
